A direct content check (git rev-parse HEAD:src/export.ts or git hash-object src/export.ts) gives exactly the blob that the verification report, implementation review, and final review cite. src/export.ts is unchanged since the commit 'Add CSV export of filtered records'.

The helper's relevant dependencies (src/records/store.ts, package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, .gitignore) and all other project files are unchanged since the final review's assessed revision. The only later commits add the final review record and this synchronization record.

No other discrepancy exists. docs/usage.md and README.md match the identities the documentation record and final review cite, both test commands pass, and the full synchronization gate can pass once D-001 is withdrawn.
